ev.q: The rate in 2015 was the highest for females for the 1975–2015 period.
The rates for females then doubled from 2007 to 2015 (from 2.4 to 5.1).
The suicide rate for males aged 15–19 years increased from 12.0 to 18.1 per 100,000 population
Rates for females aged 15–19 were lower than for males aged 15–19
declined to 10.8 by 2007, and then increased 31% to 14.2 by 2015.
Source: CDC. National Vital Statistics System, mortality data.
